Nagle is disabled for sends. The page uses xterm.js 6.0.0 and renders with its WebGL addon and falls back to the DOM renderer if WebGL is unavailable or its context is lost.
  • Cleanup: one-second close grace; callback-safe abort also runs offline. Heartbeat pings every 30 seconds with a 20-second pong timeout; the third consecutive miss without browser activity releases ownership.

docs.title: Terminal performance diagnostics
docs.text:
Read the Ctrl-] s counters Fields Meaning frames, bytes Original TCP-accepted output; excludes retries and headers retransmits, write_blocks, flush_failures Application retries, enqueue backpressure and explicit burst-flush failures timeouts Sessions released by heartbeat/output timeout window_full_polls, window_wait_max_us Full-window service passes and longest full interval ack_max_us Longest first-enqueue to consumption-ACK interval; includes transport and browser scheduling net_poll_gap_max_us Longest gap between CYW43 polls, including storage/USB work and pauses [webbuf] frames, retained, staged, peak Finalized frames, retained/staged payload and high-water marks [webbatch] avg_bytes, max_bytes, small_le16, full Original-frame sizes/counts; excludes retries [consolebuf] rx, tx, peak Console occupancy, capacity and high-water marks

Compare deltas for the same workload. Small frames are not inherently a fault; full windows plus high ACK age suggest consumer/transport pressure. bytes / frames measures batching, not throughput.

Occupancy clears on handover; peaks survive it. Web counters reset on reboot; console peaks reset on initialization. Counters wrap modulo 2^32; microsecond maxima saturate at UINT32_MAX. Fields are individual atomic snapshots, not one transaction.

Pre-batching baseline, 22 Oct 2026: CLOCK delivered 19 redraws in 20 seconds (97.5 ms median, 926.2 ms maximum; longest internal gap 863.5 ms). Median payload was 7 bytes; browser consumption was 0.3 ms at p95. This is not evidence of a post-change speedup.

docs.title: Required Integration Order
docs.text:
Preserve the Phase 9 startup sequence
  1. Initialize safe GPIOs and console/control queues.
  2. Start core 1; initialize its alarm pool, USB and flash lockout.
  3. With RESET held, recover the journal, load SRAM and independently verify it.
  4. Initialize storage/service queues before enabling workers; enable the trap and 20 MHz run clock.

Boot/core-1 failure leaves RESET asserted. Core 0 continually services flash ownership requests. Stop drains disk/service/provisioning work before holding RESET; reboot reloads CP/M. Use dedicated builds for RAM/clock qualification.

docs.title: Maintained source
docs.text:
Phase 10 compiles the Phase 9 application with Z80_STAGE09_AUTOBOOT=1 and Z80_STAGE10_NETWORK=1; it does not maintain a separate loader.

  • Phase 10 build configuration
  • Browser page and update tool (CMake compresses changes automatically)
  • WebSocket server fork (publish submodule changes to the fork before updating the parent gitlink)
Automatic loader shared with Phase 9

#endif

enum {
  RUN_CLOCK_HZ = 20000000,
  SYSTEM_CLOCK_HZ = 120000000,
  USB_COMMAND_ESCAPE = 0x1D,
  USB_REPORT_CONNECTION = 0x100,
  USB_CONFIG_REBOOT = 0x101,
  DIAGNOSTIC_BYTES = Z80_FLASH_DISK_SLOT_COUNT * Z80_FLASH_DISK_SLOT_BYTES,
  CPU_RUNNING = 1u << 0,
  CPU_STOPPING = 1u << 1,
  CPU_LOADING = 1u << 2,
  USB_CONNECTED = 1u << 0,
  USB_BROWSER = 1u << 1,
  USB_SETUP = 1u << 2,
};

static bool boot_attempted;
static bool image_verified;

static queue_t control_commands;

#ifdef Z80_STAGE10_NETWORK

static absolute_time_t web_reboot_deadline;
_Alignas(8) static uint32_t core1_network_stack[8192 / sizeof(uint32_t)];
#endif
static bool stop_requested;
static bool flush_submitted;
static bool bios_announced;
static bool ccp_announced;
static bool previous_cr;
static bool boot_timed_out;
static bool reset_was_watchdog;
static z80_io_trap_reset_fault_t reset_fault;
static const char *boot_failure;
static uint32_t boot_markers;
static uint32_t flash_pause_request;
static uint32_t flash_paused;
static bool flash_resuming;
static uint32_t reported_rx_drops;
static uint32_t reported_tx_drops;
static absolute_time_t boot_deadline;
static volatile bool diagnostic_active;
static volatile uint32_t diagnostic_count;
static volatile uint32_t diagnostic_result;
static uint32_t diagnostic_next_progress;
static uint32_t diagnostic_fault_offset;
static uint8_t diagnostic_expected;
static uint8_t diagnostic_actual;

static void service_usb(void);

static void publish_cpu_state(void) {
  __atomic_store_n(&cpu_state,
                   (running ? CPU_RUNNING : 0) |
                   (stop_requested ? CPU_STOPPING : 0) |
                   (loading ? CPU_LOADING : 0), __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
}

static uint8_t __not_in_flash_func(virtual_read)(uint8_t port, void *context) {
  (void)context;
  switch (port) {
  case 0x00:
  case 0x01:
    return z80_terminal_io_read(port);
  case 0x10:
  case 0x11:
  case 0x12:
  case 0x13:
  case 0x14:
    return z80_flash_disk_io_read(port);
  case IO_SERVICE_COMMAND_PORT:
  case IO_SERVICE_REQUEST_PORT:
  case IO_SERVICE_RESPONSE_PORT:
  case IO_TIMER_PORT:
  case HTTP_COMMAND_PORT:
  case HTTP_DATA_PORT:
    return z80_io_port_in(port);
  default:
    return 0xFF;
  }
}

static void __not_in_flash_func(diagnostic_byte)(uint8_t value) {
  uint32_t offset = diagnostic_count;
  if (offset < DIAGNOSTIC_BYTES) {
    const uint8_t *source =
        (const uint8_t *)(XIP_BASE + Z80_FLASH_DISK_OFFSET);
    if (value != source[offset] && diagnostic_result == 0) {
      diagnostic_fault_offset = offset;
      diagnostic_expected = source[offset];
      diagnostic_actual = value;
      diagnostic_result = 0xE1;
    }
  } else {
    diagnostic_result = 0xE1;
  }
  diagnostic_count = offset + 1;
}

static void __not_in_flash_func(boot_report)(uint8_t value) {
  if (diagnostic_active) {
    if (diagnostic_result == 0)
      diagnostic_result = value == 0x5A &&
                          diagnostic_count == DIAGNOSTIC_BYTES ? 0x5A : 0xE1;
  } else if (value == Z80_BOOT_REPORT_BIOS) {
    __atomic_fetch_or(&boot_markers, 1u, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
  } else if (value == Z80_BOOT_REPORT_CCP) {
    __atomic_fetch_or(&boot_markers, 2u, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
  }
}

static void __not_in_flash_func(virtual_write)(uint8_t port, uint8_t value,
                                              void *context) {
  (void)context;
  switch (port) {
  case 0x00:
    z80_terminal_io_write(port, value);
    break;
  case Z80_BOOT_REPORT_PORT:
    boot_report(value);
    break;
  case 0x06:
    if (diagnostic_active)
      diagnostic_byte(value);
    break;
  case 0x10:
  case 0x11:
  case 0x12:
  case 0x13:
  case 0x14:
    z80_flash_disk_io_write(port, value);
    break;
  case IO_SERVICE_COMMAND_PORT:
  case IO_SERVICE_REQUEST_PORT:
  case IO_SERVICE_RESPONSE_PORT:
  case IO_TIMER_PORT:
  case HTTP_COMMAND_PORT:
  case HTTP_DATA_PORT:
    z80_io_port_out(port, value);
    break;
  default:
    break;
  }
}

static void core1_service(void) {
  bool active = __atomic_load_n(&workers_ready, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
  if (active) {
    if (__atomic_load_n(&flash_pause_request, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) {
      if (!__atomic_load_n(&flash_paused, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) {
        z80_flash_core1_service();
        z80_io_ports_core1_service();
#ifdef Z80_STAGE10_NETWORK
        z80_network_setup_core1_service();
#endif
        if (z80_flash_disk_quiescent() && z80_io_ports_quiescent()
#ifdef Z80_STAGE10_NETWORK
            && z80_network_setup_quiescent()
#endif
        )
          __atomic_store_n(&flash_paused, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
      }
    } else {
      __atomic_store_n(&flash_paused, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
      z80_flash_core1_service();
      z80_io_ports_core1_service();
#ifdef Z80_STAGE10_NETWORK
      z80_network_setup_core1_service();
#endif
    }
  }
  z80_usb_console_service();
  service_usb();
#ifdef Z80_STAGE10_NETWORK
  if (active) {
    if (__atomic_load_n(&flash_pause_request, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE))
      z80_network_terminal_core1_service();
    else
      z80_network_core1_service();
  }
  if (active) {
    uint32_t state = __atomic_load_n(&cpu_state, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    z80_matrix_core1_service(
        (state & (CPU_RUNNING | CPU_STOPPING | CPU_LOADING)) == CPU_RUNNING &&
        !__atomic_load_n(&flash_pause_request, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE));
  }
#endif
}

static void core1_main(void) {
  bool flash_ready = flash_safe_execute_core_init();
  bool usb_ready = z80_usb_console_init();
  if (!flash_ready || !usb_ready)
    printf("\n[diag] FAIL: core 1 USB/flash-safe initialization.\n");
  __atomic_store_n(&core1_ready, flash_ready && usb_ready ? 1u : 2u,
                    __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
  while (true) {
    if (usb_ready)
      core1_service();
    tight_loop_contents();
  }
}

static void hold_cpu(void) {
  z80_io_trap_disable();
  z80_cpu_fail_closed();
  running = false;
  image_verified = false;
  stop_requested = false;
  diagnostic_active = false;
}

static const char *fault_name(z80_flash_fault_point_t point) {
  static const char *const names[] = {
    "none", "after journal data", "after journal header",
    "after target erase", "after partial target program",
    "after target verification", "after journal header clear",
    "safe-execute entry failure", "safe-execute exit failure",
  };
  return point <= Z80_FLASH_FAULT_SAFE_EXECUTE_EXIT
             ? names[(unsigned int)point] : "invalid";
}

static const char *boot_error_name(z80_boot_error_t error) {
  static const char *const names[] = {
    "none", "journal recovery",
    "manifest (requires 65536 bytes and JP FC00h)",
    "payload CRC", "loader controls", "SRAM write", "SRAM read",
    "SRAM mismatch", "flash-safe core initialization", "cancelled",
  };
  return (unsigned int)error < sizeof(names) / sizeof(names[0])
             ? names[(unsigned int)error] : "invalid";
}

static bool observe_boot(const z80_boot_status_t *status, void *context) {
  (void)context;
  static const char *const phases[] = {
    "journal recovery", "manifest/CRC validation", "SRAM load",
    "SRAM verify", "verified; RESET held LOW",
  };
  if (status->completed % 4096u == 0 &&
      (!Z80_STAGE09_AUTOBOOT ||
       (__atomic_load_n(&usb_state, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) & USB_CONNECTED))) {
    printf("[boot] %s: %lu/%lu\n", phases[status->phase],
           (unsigned long)status->completed, (unsigned long)status->total);
  }
  if (Z80_STAGE09_AUTOBOOT)
    return true;
  return !__atomic_load_n(&load_cancelled, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) &&
         (__atomic_load_n(&usb_state, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) & USB_CONNECTED);
}

static void load_image(void) {
  if (boot_attempted || running || runtime_started) {
    printf("\n[diag] Load already attempted; stop and reboot Pico to reload.\n");
    return;
  }
  boot_attempted = true;
  loading = true;
  __atomic_store_n(&load_cancelled, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
  publish_cpu_state();
  if (!Z80_STAGE09_AUTOBOOT)
    printf("\n[boot] Load/verify only; x cancels at a 256-byte boundary.\n");
  bool loaded = z80_flash_storage_init_observed(observe_boot, NULL);
  loading = false;
  publish_cpu_state();
  if (!loaded) {
    const z80_boot_status_t *status = z80_flash_boot_status();
    boot_failure = boot_error_name(status->error);
    hold_cpu();
    printf("[boot] FAIL: %s phase=%u completed=%lu address=%04x "
           "expected=%02x actual=%02x; RESET held LOW\n",
           boot_error_name(status->error), (unsigned int)status->phase,
           (unsigned long)status->completed, status->address,
           status->expected, status->actual);
    return;
  }
  image_verified = true;
  if (!Z80_STAGE09_AUTOBOOT)
    printf("[boot] PASS: 65536 bytes loaded and independently read back; "
           "CPU not running. Ctrl-] g starts CP/M at %lu MHz.\n",
           (unsigned long)(RUN_CLOCK_HZ / 1000000u));
}

static void start_cpm(void) {
  if (!image_verified || running || runtime_started) {
    printf("\n[diag] Start rejected: first load/verify with Ctrl-] l; "
           "a stopped run requires Pico reboot.\n");
    return;
  }
  __atomic_store_n(&boot_markers, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
  bios_announced = ccp_announced = false;
  boot_timed_out = false;
  z80_io_ports_init();
  runtime_started = true;
  if (!z80_io_trap_enable(virtual_read, virtual_write, NULL) ||
      !z80_cpu_release_reset_and_run(RUN_CLOCK_HZ)) {
    boot_failure = "trap/clock start";
    hold_cpu();
    printf("[boot] FAIL: trap/clock start; RESET held LOW\n");
    return;
  }
  running = true;
  __atomic_store_n(&workers_ready, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
  boot_deadline = make_timeout_time_ms(10000);
  if (!Z80_STAGE09_AUTOBOOT)
    printf("\n[boot] CPU released from reset; configured clock=%lu Hz. "
           "Waiting for BIOS evidence, not yet a CP/M PASS.\n",
           (unsigned long)z80_clock_get_hz());
}

static void start_disk_diagnostic(void) {
  if (!image_verified || runtime_started || running) {
    printf("\n[diag] Disk test requires Ctrl-] l and no prior run.\n");
    return;
  }
  image_verified = false;
  diagnostic_count = diagnostic_result = 0;
  diagnostic_fault_offset = UINT32_MAX;
  diagnostic_next_progress = 65536;
  if (!z80_cpu_load_and_verify(z80_disk_diagnostic,
                               sizeof(z80_disk_diagnostic))) {
    hold_cpu();
    printf("\n[diag] FAIL: disk diagnostic load/readback; RESET held LOW\n");
    return;
  }
  diagnostic_active = true;
  if (!z80_io_trap_enable(virtual_read, virtual_write, NULL) ||
      !z80_cpu_release_reset_and_run(RUN_CLOCK_HZ)) {
    hold_cpu();
    printf("\n[diag] FAIL: disk diagnostic start; RESET held LOW\n");
    return;
  }
  running = true;
  boot_deadline = make_timeout_time_ms(300000);
  printf("\n[diag] Read-only Z80 INIR/OTIR disk test at %lu MHz: "
         "all 4 drives x 4096 records x 128 bytes. No disk writes. "
         "CP/M SRAM image replaced; reboot afterward.\n",
         (unsigned long)(RUN_CLOCK_HZ / 1000000u));
}

static void print_reset_status(void) {
  const char *reason = "none";
  if (reset_fault.reason == Z80_IO_TRAP_RESET_RELEASE_TIMEOUT)
    reason = "release-timeout";
  else if (reset_fault.reason == Z80_IO_TRAP_RESET_INVALID_CONTROLS)
    reason = "invalid-controls";
  printf("[reset] watchdog=%u io_fault=%s gpio=%08lx\n",
         reset_was_watchdog, reason, (unsigned long)reset_fault.gpio);
}

static void print_pio_status(void) {
  z80_banked_pio_status_t p = z80_banked_pio_status();
  printf("[pio] active=%u running=%u reads=%lu writes=%lu "
         "last=%s:%02x:%02x pc=%u/%u irq=%02x gpio=%08lx\n",
         p.active, p.running,
         (unsigned long)p.reads, (unsigned long)p.writes,
         p.read ? "IN" : "OUT", p.port, p.value, p.clock_pc, p.io_pc,
         p.irqs, (unsigned long)p.pins);
}

static void print_io_latency(void) {
  z80_banked_pio_latency_t l = z80_banked_pio_take_latency();
  if (!l.available) {
    printf("[iolat] unavailable (no DWT cycle counter)\n");
    return;
  }
  // Core-0 cost since the previous Ctrl-] s; clk_sys cycles to ns.
  const uint64_t mhz = SYSTEM_CLOCK_HZ / 1000000u;
  unsigned long long in_avg =
      l.in_count ? l.in_cycles * 1000u / mhz / l.in_count : 0;
  unsigned long long out_avg =
      l.out_count ? l.out_cycles * 1000u / mhz / l.out_count : 0;
  printf("[iolat] since last status: IN count=%lu avg=%lluns max=%lluns; "
         "OUT apply count=%lu avg=%lluns max=%lluns\n",
         (unsigned long)l.in_count, in_avg,
         (unsigned long long)l.in_max_cycles * 1000u / mhz,
         (unsigned long)l.out_count, out_avg,
         (unsigned long long)l.out_max_cycles * 1000u / mhz);
}

static void print_help(void) {
#ifdef Z80_STAGE10_NETWORK
  printf("\nStage 10: Phase 9 automatic CP/M loader plus Wi-Fi terminal.\n"
         "Ctrl-] c=system configuration; browser owns CP/M while connected, "
         "USB resumes on disconnect.\n");
#else
  printf("\nStage 9: USB CP/M terminal; nominal 20 MHz after slow loading.\n");
#endif
  printf("Ctrl-] then: l=load/verify only, g=run verified CP/M, s=status,\n"
         "t=read-only all-drive disk test after load (reboot afterward),\n"
         "x=flush then hold RESET, r=reboot when stopped, h=help,\n"
         "0=disarm, 1-8=arm one-shot flash fault (DISPOSABLE DISKS ONLY).\n"
         "Ctrl-] Ctrl-] sends literal Ctrl-]. Ordinary bytes go to CP/M.\n");
  if (!running && boot_attempted && !image_verified)
    printf("Stopped: Ctrl-] r=reboot, s=status, h=help.\n"
           "Loading/running/testing (l/g/t) requires a Pico reboot first; "
           "fault commands (0-8) require a running CPU.\n");
  else if (Z80_STAGE09_AUTOBOOT)
    printf("CP/M loads and starts automatically on Pico reset. "
           "Ctrl-] x then Ctrl-] r safely reboots into CP/M.\n");
  else
    printf("First: Ctrl-] l, then Ctrl-] g; confirm BIOS banner and A>.\n");
}

static void diagnostic_command(int command) {
  if (command == 'l') {
    load_image();
  } else if (command == 'g') {
    start_cpm();
  } else if (command == 't') {
    start_disk_diagnostic();
  } else if (command == 's') {
    print_status(true);
  } else if (command == 'h') {
    print_help();
  } else if (command == 'x') {
    if (!running || diagnostic_active) {
      hold_cpu();
      printf("\n[diag] RESET held LOW; reboot required before a new run.\n");
      print_help();
    } else {
      stop_requested = true;
      flush_submitted = false;
      __atomic_store_n(&flash_pause_request, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
      printf("\n[diag] Stop requested; waiting for disk completion/flush.\n");
    }
  } else if (command == 'r') {
    if (running || stop_requested)
      printf("\n[diag] Reboot rejected: stop and flush with Ctrl-] x first.\n");
    else
      watchdog_reboot(0, 0, 0);
  } else if (command >= '0' && command <= '8') {
    if (!running) {
      printf("\n[diag] Fault command rejected: CPU is not running.\n");
      return;
    }
    z80_flash_fault_point_t point =
        (z80_flash_fault_point_t)(command - '0');
    z80_flash_disk_arm_fault(point);
    printf("\n[diag] Armed: %s; next disk write/flush may reboot Pico.\n",
           fault_name(point));
  } else {
    printf("\n[diag] Unknown command; Ctrl-] h for help.\n");
  }
}

static void forward_terminal_byte(uint8_t value) {
  if (value == 0)
    return;
  if (value == '\n' && previous_cr) {
    previous_cr = false;
    return;
  }
  previous_cr = value == '\r';
#ifdef Z80_STAGE10_NETWORK
  z80_terminal_usb_receive(value);
#else
  z80_terminal_receive(&value, 1);
#endif
}

static void receive_usb_byte(uint8_t value) {
  uint32_t state = __atomic_load_n(&cpu_state, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
  if (command_pending) {
    command_pending = false;
    if (value != USB_COMMAND_ESCAPE) {
#ifdef Z80_STAGE10_NETWORK
      if (value == 'c') {
        if ((state & (CPU_RUNNING | CPU_STOPPING)) == CPU_RUNNING)
          z80_network_setup_request();
        else
          printf("\n[config] Rejected: CP/M must be running, not stopping.\n");
        return;
      }
#endif
      if (value == 'x' && (state & CPU_LOADING) && !Z80_STAGE09_AUTOBOOT)
        __atomic_store_n(&load_cancelled, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
      else {
        uint16_t command = value;
        if (!queue_try_add(&control_commands, &command))
          printf("\n[diag] FAIL: supervisor command queue full; retry command.\n");
      }
      return;
    }
  } else if (value == USB_COMMAND_ESCAPE) {
    ansi_input_reset();
    command_pending = true;
    return;
  }
  if (state & CPU_LOADING) {
    if (value == 'x' && !Z80_STAGE09_AUTOBOOT)
      __atomic_store_n(&load_cancelled, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    return;
  }
#ifdef Z80_STAGE10_NETWORK
  if ((state & (CPU_RUNNING | CPU_STOPPING)) == CPU_RUNNING &&
      z80_network_setup_input(value))
    return;
  if (z80_terminal_browser_connected())
    return;
#endif
  if (!(state & CPU_RUNNING)) {
    if (Z80_STAGE09_AUTOBOOT)
      printf("\n[diag] CPU held; Ctrl-] s for status, "
             "Ctrl-] r to retry automatic boot.\n");
    else
      printf("\n[diag] CPU held; use Ctrl-] l then Ctrl-] g.\n");
    return;
  }
  forward_terminal_byte(
      ansi_input_process(value, to_ms_since_boot(get_absolute_time())));
}

static void service_usb(void) {
  bool connected = stdio_usb_connected();
  uint32_t state = __atomic_load_n(&cpu_state, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
  if (state != previous_cpu_state) {
    ansi_input_reset();
    previous_cr = false;
    previous_cpu_state = state;
  }
#ifdef Z80_STAGE10_NETWORK
  if (connected != usb_was_connected)
    z80_terminal_usb_connected(connected);
  bool browser_connected = z80_terminal_browser_connected();
  if (browser_connected != browser_was_connected) {
    ansi_input_reset();
    previous_cr = false;
    browser_was_connected = browser_connected;
  }
  z80_network_setup_usb_service(
      connected, (state & (CPU_RUNNING | CPU_STOPPING)) == CPU_RUNNING);
  if (z80_network_setup_reboot_requested()) {
    uint16_t command = USB_CONFIG_REBOOT;
    if (queue_try_add(&control_commands, &command)) {
      z80_network_setup_reboot_queued();
      config_reboot_queue_full = false;
    } else if (!config_reboot_queue_full) {
      printf("\n[config] Supervisor queue full; retrying orderly reboot.\n");
      config_reboot_queue_full = true;
    }
  }
#else
  z80_terminal_set_connected(connected);
#endif
  __atomic_store_n(&usb_state, (connected ? USB_CONNECTED : 0)
#ifdef Z80_STAGE10_NETWORK
                   | (browser_connected ? USB_BROWSER : 0)
                   | (z80_network_setup_active() ? USB_SETUP : 0)
#endif
                   , __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
  if (connected != usb_was_connected)
    ansi_input_reset();
  if (connected && !usb_was_connected) {
    command_pending = false;
    previous_cr = false;
    uint16_t command = USB_REPORT_CONNECTION;
    if (!queue_try_add(&control_commands, &command))
      printf("\n[diag] FAIL: connection report queue full; Ctrl-] s for status.\n");
  }
  usb_was_connected = connected;
  if (!connected)
    return;
  for (unsigned int count = 0; count < 32; ++count) {
    int input = getchar_timeout_us(0);
    if (input < 0)
      break;
    receive_usb_byte((uint8_t)input);
  }
  if ((state & CPU_RUNNING) && !command_pending
#ifdef Z80_STAGE10_NETWORK
      && !z80_network_setup_active() && !z80_terminal_browser_connected()
#endif
  )
    forward_terminal_byte(
        ansi_input_process(0, to_ms_since_boot(get_absolute_time())));
  if (connected && z80_terminal_output_pending()
#ifdef Z80_STAGE10_NETWORK
      && !z80_network_setup_active() && !z80_terminal_browser_connected()
#endif
  ) {
    uint8_t data[64];
    size_t capacity = tud_cdc_write_available();
    if (capacity > sizeof(data))
      capacity = sizeof(data);
    size_t count = z80_terminal_peek(data, capacity);
    if (count) {
      size_t accepted = z80_usb_console_write(data, count);
      z80_terminal_supply(data, accepted);
    }
  }
  uint32_t rx = z80_terminal_rx_drop_count();
  uint32_t tx = z80_terminal_tx_drop_count();
  if (rx != reported_rx_drops || tx != reported_tx_drops) {
    printf("\n[diag] FAIL: terminal overflow rx=%lu tx=%lu; "
           "reduce paste/output rate and repeat acceptance.\n",
           (unsigned long)rx, (unsigned long)tx);
    reported_rx_drops = rx;
    reported_tx_drops = tx;
  }
}

static void service_control(void) {
#ifdef Z80_STAGE10_NETWORK
  if (z80_web_terminal_reboot_status() == Z80_WEB_REBOOT_REQUESTED) {
    if (config_reboot_after_stop || config_reboot_ready || stop_requested ||
        !running || diagnostic_active || z80_flash_disk_has_fatal_error()) {
      z80_web_terminal_set_reboot_status(Z80_WEB_REBOOT_REJECTED);
    } else if (z80_web_terminal_begin_reboot()) {
      web_reboot_active = true;
      web_reboot_deadline = make_timeout_time_ms(30000);
      config_reboot_after_stop = true;
      diagnostic_command('x');
    }
  }
  if (web_reboot_active &&
      z80_web_terminal_reboot_status() == Z80_WEB_REBOOT_TIMEOUT) {
    web_reboot_active = false;
    config_reboot_after_stop = config_reboot_ready = false;
    printf("\n[web] Reboot cancelled after network-side timeout; "
           "orderly stop remains pending.\n");
  }
  if (web_reboot_active && z80_flash_disk_has_fatal_error()) {
    web_reboot_active = false;
    config_reboot_after_stop = config_reboot_ready = false;
    z80_web_terminal_set_reboot_status(Z80_WEB_REBOOT_STORAGE_ERROR);
  }
  if (web_reboot_active && time_reached(web_reboot_deadline)) {
    web_reboot_active = false;
    config_reboot_after_stop = config_reboot_ready = false;
    // Keep draining/stopping; never force a reset through an unfinished write.
    z80_web_terminal_set_reboot_status(Z80_WEB_REBOOT_TIMEOUT);
    printf("\n[web] Reboot timed out; automatic restart cancelled. "
           "Orderly stop remains pending.\n");
  }
  if (config_reboot_ready && time_reached(config_reboot_deadline)) {
    config_reboot_ready = false;
    watchdog_reboot(0, 0, 0);
    return;
  }
#endif
  uint16_t command;
  if (queue_try_remove(&control_commands, &command)) {
#ifdef Z80_STAGE10_NETWORK
    if (command == USB_CONFIG_REBOOT) {
      if (!running || diagnostic_active || z80_flash_disk_has_fatal_error()) {
        printf("\n[config] FAIL: automatic reboot rejected: CP/M is not "
               "running normally or storage has failed. CPU state unchanged; "
               "inspect Ctrl-] s before manual recovery.\n");
      } else {
        config_reboot_after_stop = true;
        if (!stop_requested)
          diagnostic_command('x');
      }
    } else if ((config_reboot_after_stop || config_reboot_ready) &&
               command != 's' && command != 'h' &&
               command != USB_REPORT_CONNECTION) {
      printf("\n[config] Orderly reboot in progress; command rejected.\n");
    } else
#endif
    if (command == USB_REPORT_CONNECTION) {
      if (!Z80_STAGE09_AUTOBOOT) {
        print_help();
        print_status(false);
      } else if (!running && !loading && boot_attempted) {
        printf("\n[boot] %s; RESET held LOW. Ctrl-] s for status, "
               "Ctrl-] r to reboot.\n",
               boot_failure != NULL ? "FAIL: automatic CP/M boot stopped"
                                    : "CP/M stopped");
        print_status(false);
      }
    } else if (startup_failed && command != 'r' && command != 's' &&
               command != 'h') {
      printf("\n[diag] Rejected: core 1 initialization failed; CPU held reset.\n");
    } else {
      diagnostic_command(command);
    }
  }
  publish_cpu_state();
}

static void service_run(void) {
  if (!running)
    return;
  if (diagnostic_active) {
    uint32_t interrupts = save_and_disable_interrupts();
    uint32_t count = diagnostic_count;
    uint32_t result = diagnostic_result;
    restore_interrupts(interrupts);
    if (result != 0 || time_reached(boot_deadline)) {
      hold_cpu();
      printf("\n[diag] %s: disk bytes checked=%lu/%u "
             "fault_offset=%08lx expected=%02x actual=%02x; "
             "RESET held LOW; Ctrl-] r then load CP/M again.\n",
             result == 0x5A ? "PASS" : "FAIL",
             (unsigned long)count, DIAGNOSTIC_BYTES,
             (unsigned long)diagnostic_fault_offset,
             diagnostic_expected, diagnostic_actual);
    } else if (count >= diagnostic_next_progress) {
      printf("[diag] disk bytes checked=%lu/%u\n",
             (unsigned long)count, DIAGNOSTIC_BYTES);
      diagnostic_next_progress += 65536;
    }
    return;
  }
  uint32_t markers = __atomic_load_n(&boot_markers, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
  if ((markers & 1u) && !bios_announced) {
    bios_announced = true;
    if (!Z80_STAGE09_AUTOBOOT)
      printf("\n[boot] Observed BIOS cold-entry report from Z80.\n");
  }
  if ((markers & 2u) && !ccp_announced) {
    ccp_announced = true;
    if (!Z80_STAGE09_AUTOBOOT)
      printf("\n[boot] Observed BIOS handoff to CCP; "
             "confirm A>, DIR and transient/warm-boot tests manually.\n");
  }
  if (!boot_timed_out && (!bios_announced || !ccp_announced) &&
      time_reached(boot_deadline)) {
    boot_failure = "BIOS/CCP evidence timeout";
    printf("\n[boot] FAIL: BIOS/CCP evidence timeout; stopping safely. "
           "Rebuild/provision the matching boot package if markers are absent.\n");
    print_pio_status();
    stop_requested = true;
    boot_timed_out = true;
    __atomic_store_n(&flash_pause_request, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
  }
  if (z80_flash_disk_has_fatal_error()) {
#ifdef Z80_STAGE10_NETWORK
    if (config_reboot_after_stop) {
      config_reboot_after_stop = false;
      printf("\n[config] FAIL: storage error; automatic reboot cancelled.\n");
    }
    if (web_reboot_active) {
      web_reboot_active = false;
      z80_web_terminal_set_reboot_status(Z80_WEB_REBOOT_STORAGE_ERROR);
    }
#endif
    boot_failure = "fatal storage error";
    hold_cpu();
    printf("\n[diag] FAIL: fatal storage error; RESET held LOW. "
           "Reboot to recover; preserve USB log.\n");
    return;
  }
#ifdef Z80_STAGE10_NETWORK
  if (bios_announced && ccp_announced && !stop_requested &&
      z80_web_terminal_reboot_status() == Z80_WEB_REBOOT_IDLE)
    z80_web_terminal_set_reboot_status(Z80_WEB_REBOOT_CPM_READY);
#endif
  if (!stop_requested)
    return;
  if (flash_resuming) {
    if (!__atomic_load_n(&flash_paused, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) {
      flash_resuming = false;
      flush_submitted = false;
      __atomic_store_n(&flash_pause_request, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    }
    return;
  }
  if (__atomic_load_n(&flash_paused, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) {
    // PIO completes OUTs ahead of core 0. Park the Z80 between machine cycles,
    // then apply every completed OUT before deciding, so the disk state seen
    // here is exactly what the Z80 has issued.
    if (!z80_cpu_request_bus(500000)) {
      boot_failure = "stop bus request";
      hold_cpu();
      printf("\n[diag] FAIL: Z80 did not release the bus for stop; "
             "RESET held LOW.\n");
      return;
    }
    uint32_t interrupts = save_and_disable_interrupts();
    z80_io_trap_drain_writes();
    bool quiescent = z80_flash_disk_quiescent();
    if (quiescent)
      hold_cpu();
    restore_interrupts(interrupts);
    if (!quiescent && !z80_cpu_release_bus(500000)) {
      boot_failure = "stop bus release";
      hold_cpu();
      printf("\n[diag] FAIL: Z80 bus release after stop check; "
             "RESET held LOW.\n");
      return;
    }
    if (quiescent) {
#ifdef Z80_STAGE10_NETWORK
      if (config_reboot_after_stop) {
        config_reboot_after_stop = false;
        config_reboot_ready = true;
        config_reboot_deadline = make_timeout_time_ms(1000);
        if (web_reboot_active)
          z80_web_terminal_set_reboot_status(Z80_WEB_REBOOT_RESTARTING);
        printf("\n[config] Disks flushed; RESET held LOW, clock stopped. "
               "Rebooting in one second.\n");
      } else
#endif
      {
        printf("\n[diag] Disk quiescent; RESET held LOW, clock stopped. "
               "Ctrl-] r reboots/reloads the supervisor.\n");
        print_help();
      }
    } else {
      flash_resuming = true;
      __atomic_store_n(&flash_pause_request, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    }
  } else if (!flush_submitted) {
    z80_flash_disk_request_flush();
    flush_submitted = true;
  }
}

int main(void) {
  z80_safe_startup();
  reset_was_watchdog = watchdog_caused_reboot();
  reset_fault = z80_io_trap_take_reset_fault();
  set_sys_clock_pll(1200000000, 5, 2);
  z80_terminal_queue_init();
  queue_init(&control_commands, sizeof(uint16_t), 4);
  z80_usb_console_prepare();
#ifdef Z80_STAGE10_NETWORK
  z80_network_setup_init();
#endif
  bool clock_ready = clock_get_hz(clk_sys) == SYSTEM_CLOCK_HZ;
#ifdef Z80_STAGE10_NETWORK
  multicore_launch_core1_with_stack(core1_main, core1_network_stack,
                                   sizeof(core1_network_stack));
#else
  multicore_launch_core1(core1_main);
#endif
  core1_started = true;
  absolute_time_t ready_deadline = make_timeout_time_ms(1000);
  while (!__atomic_load_n(&core1_ready, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) &&
         !time_reached(ready_deadline))
    tight_loop_contents();
  if (!clock_ready ||
      __atomic_load_n(&core1_ready, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) != 1) {
    z80_cpu_fail_closed();
    startup_failed = true;
    boot_failure = !clock_ready ? "expected 120 MHz supervisor clock"
                               : "core 1 USB/flash-safe initialization";
    while (true) {
      printf("FAIL: %s; CPU held reset\n", boot_failure);
      service_control();
      busy_wait_us_32(1000000);
      tight_loop_contents();
    }
  }
  if (Z80_STAGE09_AUTOBOOT) {
    load_image();
    if (image_verified)
      start_cpm();
  }
  publish_cpu_state();
  while (true) {
    if (__atomic_load_n(&workers_ready, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE))
      z80_flash_core0_service();
    if (core1_started && z80_io_ports_reboot_requested()) {
      hold_cpu();
      watchdog_reboot(0, 0, 0);
      while (true)
        tight_loop_contents();
    }
    service_control();
    service_run();
    publish_cpu_state();
    tight_loop_contents();
  }
}
Shared terminal queues and transport handover 
#include "z80sbc/terminal.h"

#include <string.h>

#include "pico/critical_section.h"
#include "pico/stdlib.h"

enum {
  TERM_DATA_PORT = 0x00,
  TERM_STATUS_PORT = 0x01,
  TERM_RX_DEPTH = 128,
  TERM_TX_DEPTH = 512,
  TERM_STATUS_RX_READY = 1u << 0,
  TERM_STATUS_TX_ROOM = 1u << 1,
  TERM_STATUS_CLIENT = 1u << 7,
};

typedef struct {
  uint8_t *data;
  size_t capacity;
  size_t head;
  size_t count;
  size_t peak;
} terminal_ring_t;

static uint8_t rx_data[TERM_RX_DEPTH];
static uint8_t tx_data[TERM_TX_DEPTH];
static terminal_ring_t rx_queue = {rx_data, TERM_RX_DEPTH, 0, 0, 0};
static terminal_ring_t tx_queue = {tx_data, TERM_TX_DEPTH, 0, 0, 0};
static critical_section_t terminal_lock;
static uint32_t client_connected;
static uint32_t browser_connected;
/* Let core 1 skip empty output polls without taking the core 0 I/O lock. */
static uint32_t tx_pending;
static bool usb_connected;
static uint32_t rx_drops;
static uint32_t tx_drops;

/* Counts change only under terminal_lock, but are stored atomically so the
 * core-0 status poll can read them without the cross-core lock. */
static inline void ring_set_count(terminal_ring_t *ring, size_t count) {
  __atomic_store_n(&ring->count, count, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

static inline size_t ring_count(const terminal_ring_t *ring) {
  return __atomic_load_n(&ring->count, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

static void clear_queues(void) {
  rx_queue.head = tx_queue.head = 0;
  ring_set_count(&rx_queue, 0);
  ring_set_count(&tx_queue, 0);
  __atomic_store_n(&tx_pending, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
}

static void __not_in_flash_func(ring_add)(terminal_ring_t *ring, uint8_t value) {
  size_t count = ring->count;
  ring->data[(ring->head + count) & (ring->capacity - 1)] = value;
  ring_set_count(ring, ++count);
  if (count > ring->peak)
    ring->peak = count;
}

static void __not_in_flash_func(ring_drop_oldest)(terminal_ring_t *ring) {
  ring->head = (ring->head + 1) & (ring->capacity - 1);
  ring_set_count(ring, ring->count - 1);
}

static size_t ring_peek(const terminal_ring_t *ring, uint8_t *data,
                        size_t capacity) {
  size_t count = capacity < ring->count ? capacity : ring->count;
  size_t first = ring->capacity - ring->head;
  if (first > count)
    first = count;
  memcpy(data, ring->data + ring->head, first);
  memcpy(data + first, ring->data, count - first);
  return count;
}

static size_t ring_remove(terminal_ring_t *ring, uint8_t *data,
                          size_t capacity) {
  size_t count = ring_peek(ring, data, capacity);
  ring->head = (ring->head + count) & (ring->capacity - 1);
  ring_set_count(ring, ring->count - count);
  return count;
}

void z80_terminal_queue_init(void) {
  if (!critical_section_is_initialized(&terminal_lock))
    critical_section_init(&terminal_lock);
  clear_queues();
  rx_queue.peak = tx_queue.peak = 0;
  __atomic_store_n(&client_connected, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
  __atomic_store_n(&browser_connected, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
  usb_connected = false;
  __atomic_store_n(&rx_drops, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  __atomic_store_n(&tx_drops, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

uint8_t __not_in_flash_func(z80_terminal_io_read)(uint8_t port) {
  if (port == TERM_STATUS_PORT) {
    /* Lock-free: core 0 is the only RX consumer and TX producer, so a racing
     * core 1 update can only make this poll conservative for one cycle. */
    bool connected = z80_terminal_client_connected();
    uint8_t value = 0;
    if (ring_count(&rx_queue))
      value |= TERM_STATUS_RX_READY;
    if (!connected || ring_count(&tx_queue) < TERM_TX_DEPTH)
      value |= TERM_STATUS_TX_ROOM;
    if (connected)
      value |= TERM_STATUS_CLIENT;
    return value;
  }
  if (!ring_count(&rx_queue))
    return 0;
  critical_section_enter_blocking(&terminal_lock);
  uint8_t value = 0;
  if (rx_queue.count) {
    value = rx_queue.data[rx_queue.head];
    ring_drop_oldest(&rx_queue);
  }
  critical_section_exit(&terminal_lock);
  return value;
}

void __not_in_flash_func(z80_terminal_io_write)(uint8_t port, uint8_t value) {
  if (port != TERM_DATA_PORT)
    return;
  critical_section_enter_blocking(&terminal_lock);
  if (z80_terminal_client_connected()) {
    if (tx_queue.count < TERM_TX_DEPTH) {
      bool was_empty = tx_queue.count == 0;
      ring_add(&tx_queue, value);
      if (was_empty)
        __atomic_store_n(&tx_pending, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    } else
      __atomic_fetch_add(&tx_drops, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  }
  critical_section_exit(&terminal_lock);
}

void z80_terminal_receive(const uint8_t *data, size_t length) {
  if (data == NULL)
    return;
  for (size_t index = 0; index < length; ++index) {
    critical_section_enter_blocking(&terminal_lock);
    if (rx_queue.count == TERM_RX_DEPTH) {
      ring_drop_oldest(&rx_queue);
      __atomic_fetch_add(&rx_drops, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    }
    ring_add(&rx_queue, data[index] == '\n' ? '\r' : data[index]);
    critical_section_exit(&terminal_lock);
  }
}

size_t z80_terminal_peek(uint8_t *data, size_t capacity) {
  if (data == NULL || capacity == 0 ||
      !__atomic_load_n(&tx_pending, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE))
    return 0;
  critical_section_enter_blocking(&terminal_lock);
  size_t count = ring_peek(&tx_queue, data, capacity);
  critical_section_exit(&terminal_lock);
  return count;
}

size_t z80_terminal_supply(uint8_t *data, size_t capacity) {
  if (data == NULL || capacity == 0 ||
      !__atomic_load_n(&tx_pending, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE))
    return 0;
  critical_section_enter_blocking(&terminal_lock);
  size_t count = ring_remove(&tx_queue, data, capacity);
  if (tx_queue.count == 0)
    __atomic_store_n(&tx_pending, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
  critical_section_exit(&terminal_lock);
  return count;
}

bool z80_terminal_output_pending(void) {
  return __atomic_load_n(&tx_pending, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) != 0;
}

bool z80_terminal_browser_try_receive(const uint8_t *data, size_t length) {
  if (data == NULL || length == 0 || length > TERM_RX_DEPTH)
    return false;
  critical_section_enter_blocking(&terminal_lock);
  bool accepted = z80_terminal_browser_connected() &&
                  TERM_RX_DEPTH - rx_queue.count >= length;
  if (accepted)
    for (size_t i = 0; i < length; ++i)
      ring_add(&rx_queue, data[i] == '\n' ? '\r' : data[i]);
  critical_section_exit(&terminal_lock);
  return accepted;
}

void z80_terminal_browser_connect(void) {
  critical_section_enter_blocking(&terminal_lock);
  clear_queues();
  __atomic_store_n(&browser_connected, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
  __atomic_store_n(&client_connected, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
  critical_section_exit(&terminal_lock);
}

void z80_terminal_set_connected(bool connected) {
  critical_section_enter_blocking(&terminal_lock);
  __atomic_store_n(&client_connected, connected, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
  if (!connected) {
    tx_queue.head = 0;
    ring_set_count(&tx_queue, 0);
    __atomic_store_n(&tx_pending, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
  }
  critical_section_exit(&terminal_lock);
}

void z80_terminal_browser_disconnect(void) {
  critical_section_enter_blocking(&terminal_lock);
  if (z80_terminal_browser_connected()) {
    __atomic_store_n(&browser_connected, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    __atomic_store_n(&client_connected, usb_connected, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    clear_queues();
  }
  critical_section_exit(&terminal_lock);
}

bool z80_terminal_browser_connected(void) {
  return __atomic_load_n(&browser_connected, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) != 0;
}

void z80_terminal_usb_connected(bool connected) {
  critical_section_enter_blocking(&terminal_lock);
  if (!z80_terminal_browser_connected()) {
    __atomic_store_n(&client_connected, connected, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    if (usb_connected != connected)
      clear_queues();
  }
  usb_connected = connected;
  critical_section_exit(&terminal_lock);
}

void z80_terminal_usb_receive(uint8_t value) {
  critical_section_enter_blocking(&terminal_lock);
  if (usb_connected && !z80_terminal_browser_connected()) {
    if (rx_queue.count == TERM_RX_DEPTH) {
      ring_drop_oldest(&rx_queue);
      __atomic_fetch_add(&rx_drops, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    }
    ring_add(&rx_queue, value == '\n' ? '\r' : value);
  }
  critical_section_exit(&terminal_lock);
}

size_t z80_terminal_usb_supply(uint8_t *data, size_t capacity) {
  if (data == NULL || capacity == 0 ||
      !__atomic_load_n(&tx_pending, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE))
    return 0;
  critical_section_enter_blocking(&terminal_lock);
  size_t count = 0;
  if (usb_connected && !z80_terminal_browser_connected()) {
    count = ring_remove(&tx_queue, data, capacity);
    if (tx_queue.count == 0)
      __atomic_store_n(&tx_pending, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
  }
  critical_section_exit(&terminal_lock);
  return count;
}

uint32_t z80_terminal_rx_drop_count(void) {
  return __atomic_load_n(&rx_drops, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

uint32_t z80_terminal_tx_drop_count(void) {
  return __atomic_load_n(&tx_drops, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

z80_terminal_buffer_stats_t z80_terminal_get_buffer_stats(void) {
  critical_section_enter_blocking(&terminal_lock);
  z80_terminal_buffer_stats_t stats = {
      (uint32_t)rx_queue.count, TERM_RX_DEPTH, (uint32_t)rx_queue.peak,
      (uint32_t)tx_queue.count, TERM_TX_DEPTH, (uint32_t)tx_queue.peak,
  };
  critical_section_exit(&terminal_lock);
  return stats;
}

bool __not_in_flash_func(z80_terminal_client_connected)(void) {
  return __atomic_load_n(&client_connected, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) != 0;
}
Core-1 network lifecycle 
#include "network_runtime.h"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include "pico/cyw43_arch.h"
#include "pico/stdlib.h"
#include "lwip/apps/sntp.h"
#include "lwip/netif.h"
#include "network_setup.h"
#include "z80sbc/io_ports.h"
#include "../common/io_service.h"

namespace {
constexpr uint32_t RETRY_DELAY_MS = 5000;
constexpr uint32_t ASSOCIATION_TIMEOUT_MS = 30000;
enum class WifiState { uninitialized, associating, online, association_backoff };
WifiState wifi_state = WifiState::uninitialized;
absolute_time_t retry_deadline = nil_time;
absolute_time_t association_deadline = nil_time;
absolute_time_t address_deadline = nil_time;
bool time_client_started;
z80_network_config_t active_config = {};
uint32_t network_generation;
char active_hostname[32];

void clear_address() {
  ++network_generation;
  z80_io_ports_set_network_address("");
  address_deadline = nil_time;
}

void start_association() {
  // lwIP copies this into the DHCP client options when it requests a lease.
  // Set it before starting each association so the router sees the same name
  // that the Z80 system information reports.
  if (z80_service_info(0, active_hostname, sizeof(active_hostname)) == 0)
    return;
  cyw43_arch_lwip_begin();
  if (netif_default != nullptr)
    netif_set_hostname(netif_default, active_hostname);
  cyw43_arch_lwip_end();
  int result = cyw43_arch_wifi_connect_async(
      active_config.ssid, active_config.password,
      active_config.password[0] ? CYW43_AUTH_WPA2_AES_PSK : CYW43_AUTH_OPEN);
  if (result == PICO_OK) {
    association_deadline = make_timeout_time_ms(ASSOCIATION_TIMEOUT_MS);
    wifi_state = WifiState::associating;
  } else {
    retry_deadline = make_timeout_time_ms(RETRY_DELAY_MS);
    wifi_state = WifiState::association_backoff;
    printf("[network] FAIL: association start=%d; retry in 5 seconds.\n", result);
  }
}

void refresh_network_address() {
  if (!time_reached(address_deadline))
    return;
  address_deadline = make_timeout_time_ms(1000);
  char address[16] = {};
  cyw43_arch_lwip_begin();
  if (netif_default != nullptr &&
      ip4addr_ntoa_r(netif_ip4_addr(netif_default), address,
                     sizeof(address)) == nullptr) {
    address[0] = '\0';
    printf("[network] FAIL: IPv4 address formatting.\n");
  }
  cyw43_arch_lwip_end();
  if (strcmp(address, "0.0.0.0") == 0)
    address[0] = '\0';
  char previous[16];
  z80_io_ports_get_network_address(previous, sizeof(previous));
  if (strcmp(previous, address) != 0)
    z80_io_ports_set_network_address(address);
}
}  // namespace

extern "C" uint32_t z80_network_generation(void) {
  return network_generation;
}

extern "C" bool z80_network_poll(void) {
  if (!z80_wireless_init())
    return false;
  cyw43_arch_poll();
  const z80_network_config_t *config = z80_network_config();
  if (config == nullptr) {
    if (wifi_state != WifiState::uninitialized) {
      clear_address();
      cyw43_wifi_leave(&cyw43_state, CYW43_ITF_STA);
      wifi_state = WifiState::uninitialized;
      active_config = {};
    }
    return false;
  }
  if (strcmp(active_config.ssid, config->ssid) != 0 ||
      strcmp(active_config.password, config->password) != 0) {
    clear_address();
    if (wifi_state != WifiState::uninitialized)
      cyw43_wifi_leave(&cyw43_state, CYW43_ITF_STA);
    active_config = *config;
    wifi_state = WifiState::uninitialized;
  }
  if (wifi_state == WifiState::uninitialized) {
    cyw43_arch_enable_sta_mode();
    start_association();
    return false;
  }
  if (wifi_state == WifiState::association_backoff) {
    if (time_reached(retry_deadline))
      start_association();
    return false;
  }

  cyw43_arch_lwip_begin();
  int status = cyw43_tcpip_link_status(&cyw43_state, CYW43_ITF_STA);
  cyw43_arch_lwip_end();
  if (wifi_state == WifiState::associating) {
    if (status == CYW43_LINK_UP) {
      int result = cyw43_wifi_pm(&cyw43_state, CYW43_NO_POWERSAVE_MODE);
      if (result != PICO_OK) {
        cyw43_wifi_leave(&cyw43_state, CYW43_ITF_STA);
        retry_deadline = make_timeout_time_ms(RETRY_DELAY_MS);
        wifi_state = WifiState::association_backoff;
        printf("[network] FAIL: disabling Wi-Fi power saving=%d; retry in 5 seconds.\n",
               result);
        return false;
      }
      cyw43_arch_lwip_begin();
      if (!time_client_started) {
        sntp_setoperatingmode(SNTP_OPMODE_POLL);
        sntp_setservername(0, "pool.ntp.org");
        sntp_init();
        time_client_started = true;
      }
      cyw43_arch_lwip_end();
      wifi_state = WifiState::online;
    } else if (status < CYW43_LINK_DOWN || time_reached(association_deadline)) {
      cyw43_wifi_leave(&cyw43_state, CYW43_ITF_STA);
      retry_deadline = make_timeout_time_ms(RETRY_DELAY_MS);
      wifi_state = WifiState::association_backoff;
      printf("[network] FAIL: association status=%d or timeout; retry in 5 seconds.\n",
             status);
      return false;
    } else {
      return false;
    }
  }
  if (status != CYW43_LINK_UP) {
    clear_address();
    cyw43_wifi_leave(&cyw43_state, CYW43_ITF_STA);
    retry_deadline = make_timeout_time_ms(RETRY_DELAY_MS);
    wifi_state = WifiState::association_backoff;
    printf("[network] Wi-Fi link lost; retry in 5 seconds.\n");
    return false;
  }
  refresh_network_address();
  return true;
}

#include <atomic>

namespace {
constexpr uint16_t SERVER_PORT = Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_PORT;
constexpr uint32_t SERVER_CONNECTIONS = 4;
constexpr uint32_t SERVER_RETRY_MS = 5000;
constexpr size_t FRAME_BYTES = Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_FRAME_BYTES;
constexpr size_t INPUT_BYTES = 64;
constexpr size_t HEADER_BYTES = 5;
constexpr size_t OUTPUT_WINDOW = Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_OUTPUT_WINDOW;
constexpr uint32_t OUTPUT_COALESCE_US = 1000;
constexpr uint32_t PROTOCOL_VERSION = 4;
constexpr uint32_t FRAME_RETRY_MS = 250;
constexpr uint32_t REBOOT_DEADLINE_MS = 35000;
constexpr uint32_t HEARTBEAT_MS = 30u * 1000u;
constexpr uint32_t PONG_TIMEOUT_MS = 20u * 1000u;
// Tolerate two misses; disconnect on the third consecutive miss.
constexpr uint8_t MAX_MISSED_PONGS = 2;
// xterm ACKs output only after its write callback runs; allow a backgrounded
// or busy browser to drain the bounded output window before restoring USB.
constexpr uint32_t OUTPUT_ACK_TIMEOUT_MS = 5u * 60u * 1000u;
enum : uint8_t {
  OUTPUT = 1, INPUT = 2, OUTPUT_ACK = 3, INPUT_ACK = 4,
  HELLO = 5, READY = 6, REBOOT = 7, REBOOT_STATUS = 8,
};

struct OutputFrame {
  uint8_t data[HEADER_BYTES + FRAME_BYTES];
  size_t length;
  absolute_time_t retry;
  absolute_time_t deadline;
  bool sent;
};
OutputFrame output_frames[OUTPUT_WINDOW];
size_t output_head;
size_t output_count;
size_t retained_output_bytes;
size_t staged_output_length;
absolute_time_t output_batch_deadline = nil_time;
z80_web_terminal_stats_t terminal_stats;
uint8_t pending_input[INPUT_BYTES];
size_t pending_input_length;
uint32_t output_sequence;
uint32_t input_sequence;
bool input_ack_pending;
bool protocol_ready;
std::atomic<uint32_t> reboot_status{Z80_WEB_REBOOT_IDLE};
uint32_t reported_reboot_status = UINT32_MAX;
// Core 1 owns this deadline. Keep it across browser disconnects so core 0
// cannot leave a request looking active forever if its main loop stalls.
absolute_time_t reboot_deadline;
bool reboot_deadline_active;
WebSocketServer *server;
bool server_started;
absolute_time_t server_retry_deadline = nil_time;
std::atomic<int32_t> active_connection{-1};
// Retain the closing session's identity until its deferred diagnostics arrive.
std::atomic<int32_t> last_disconnected_connection{-1};
std::atomic<bool> pending_connected{false};
std::atomic<bool> pending_disconnected{false};
std::atomic<uint32_t> pending_ws_close_reason{
    (uint32_t)WebSocketServer::CloseReason::unknown};
std::atomic<int32_t> pending_ws_transport_error{0};
absolute_time_t hello_retry;
absolute_time_t ping_retry;
absolute_time_t pong_deadline;
uint32_t ping_sequence;
uint8_t ping_payload[4];
bool awaiting_pong;
bool activity_since_ping;
uint8_t missed_pongs;
uint32_t session_network_generation;
bool network_online;

void increment_stat(uint32_t &counter, uint32_t amount = 1) {
  __atomic_fetch_add(&counter, amount, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

void set_disconnect_reason(z80_web_terminal_disconnect_reason_t reason) {
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.last_disconnect_reason, (uint32_t)reason,
                   __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

const char *ws_close_reason_name(WebSocketServer::CloseReason reason) {
  switch (reason) {
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::peer_tcp_closed: return "peer-tcp-closed";
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::peer_websocket_close: return "peer-ws-close";
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::invalid_websocket_input: return "invalid-ws-input";
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::receive_queue_message_limit: return "receive-queue-message-limit";
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::receive_queue_byte_limit: return "receive-queue-byte-limit";
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::pong_backpressure: return "pong-backpressure";
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::tcp_write_error: return "tcp-write-error";
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::tcp_output_error: return "tcp-output-error";
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::tcp_error: return "tcp-error";
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::close_timeout: return "close-timeout";
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::server_abort: return "server-abort";
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::local_close: return "local-close";
  default: return "unknown";
  }
}

uint32_t ws_close_reason_code(WebSocketServer::CloseReason reason) {
  switch (reason) {
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::peer_tcp_closed: return Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_WS_CLOSE_PEER_TCP_CLOSED;
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::peer_websocket_close: return Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_WS_CLOSE_PEER_WEBSOCKET_CLOSE;
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::invalid_websocket_input: return Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_WS_CLOSE_INVALID_INPUT;
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::receive_queue_message_limit: return Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_WS_CLOSE_RECEIVE_QUEUE_MESSAGE_LIMIT;
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::receive_queue_byte_limit: return Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_WS_CLOSE_RECEIVE_QUEUE_BYTE_LIMIT;
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::pong_backpressure: return Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_WS_CLOSE_PONG_BACKPRESSURE;
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::tcp_write_error: return Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_WS_CLOSE_TCP_WRITE_ERROR;
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::tcp_output_error: return Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_WS_CLOSE_TCP_OUTPUT_ERROR;
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::tcp_error: return Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_WS_CLOSE_TCP_ERROR;
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::close_timeout: return Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_WS_CLOSE_TIMEOUT;
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::server_abort: return Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_WS_CLOSE_SERVER_ABORT;
  case WebSocketServer::CloseReason::local_close: return Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_WS_CLOSE_LOCAL_CLOSE;
  default: return Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_WS_CLOSE_UNKNOWN;
  }
}

void on_close_details(WebSocketServer &, uint32_t connection,
                      WebSocketServer::CloseReason reason, int transport_error,
                      size_t queued_messages, size_t queued_bytes,
                      size_t peak_queued_messages, size_t peak_queued_bytes,
                      size_t queue_message_limit, size_t queue_byte_limit) {
  int32_t active = active_connection.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
  if (active != (int32_t)connection &&
      last_disconnected_connection.load(std::memory_order_acquire) !=
          (int32_t)connection)
    return;
  last_disconnected_connection.store((int32_t)connection,
                                      std::memory_order_release);
  pending_ws_close_reason.store((uint32_t)reason, std::memory_order_release);
  pending_ws_transport_error.store(transport_error, std::memory_order_release);
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_close_reason, ws_close_reason_code(reason),
                   __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_transport_error, transport_error,
                   __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_messages,
                   (uint32_t)queued_messages, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_bytes,
                   (uint32_t)queued_bytes, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_peak_messages,
                   (uint32_t)peak_queued_messages, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_peak_bytes,
                   (uint32_t)peak_queued_bytes, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_message_limit,
                   (uint32_t)queue_message_limit, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_byte_limit,
                   (uint32_t)queue_byte_limit, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  // A previous session may finish closing after its replacement connects.
  if (active >= 0 && active != (int32_t)connection)
    return;
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_messages,
                   active >= 0 ? (uint32_t)queued_messages : 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_bytes,
                   active >= 0 ? (uint32_t)queued_bytes : 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_peak_messages,
                   (uint32_t)peak_queued_messages, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_peak_bytes,
                   (uint32_t)peak_queued_bytes, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_message_limit,
                   (uint32_t)queue_message_limit, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_byte_limit,
                   (uint32_t)queue_byte_limit, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

void record_peak(uint32_t &counter, uint32_t value) {
  if (value > __atomic_load_n(&counter, __ATOMIC_RELAXED))
    __atomic_store_n(&counter, value, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

void publish_buffer_usage() {
  uint32_t frames = (uint32_t)output_count;
  uint32_t bytes = (uint32_t)(retained_output_bytes + staged_output_length);
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.window_frames, frames, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.retained_bytes, bytes, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.staged_bytes, (uint32_t)staged_output_length,
                   __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  record_peak(terminal_stats.window_frames_peak, frames);
  record_peak(terminal_stats.retained_bytes_peak, bytes);
}

void reset_receive_queue_usage() {
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_messages, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_bytes, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_peak_messages, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_peak_bytes, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_message_limit, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_byte_limit, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

void clear_receive_queue_current() {
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_messages, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_bytes, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

uint32_t read_sequence(const uint8_t *data) {
  return (uint32_t)data[0] | (uint32_t)data[1] << 8 |
         (uint32_t)data[2] << 16 | (uint32_t)data[3] << 24;
}

void write_sequence(uint8_t *data, uint32_t value) {
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    data[i] = (uint8_t)(value >> (8 * i));
}

void reset_session() {
  protocol_ready = false;
  reported_reboot_status = UINT32_MAX;
  input_sequence = output_sequence = 1;
  output_head = output_count = pending_input_length = 0;
  input_ack_pending = false;
  staged_output_length = 0;
  retained_output_bytes = 0;
  publish_buffer_usage();
  output_batch_deadline = nil_time;
  hello_retry = nil_time;
  ping_retry = nil_time;
  awaiting_pong = false;
  activity_since_ping = false;
  missed_pongs = 0;
  pong_deadline = nil_time;
}

void note_browser_activity() {
  missed_pongs = 0;
  if (awaiting_pong)
    activity_since_ping = true;
}

void close_connection(WebSocketServer &websocket, uint32_t connection) {
  if (!websocket.close(connection))
    printf("[network] Close frame not sent; connection scheduled for cleanup.\n");
}

void disconnect_client(z80_web_terminal_disconnect_reason_t reason) {
  int32_t connection = active_connection.exchange(-1, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
  if (connection >= 0) {
    last_disconnected_connection.store(connection, std::memory_order_release);
    set_disconnect_reason(reason);
    // Do not pair this new disconnect with a previous session's close details.
    __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_close_reason,
                     Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_WS_CLOSE_UNKNOWN, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_transport_error, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_messages, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_bytes, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_peak_messages, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_peak_bytes, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_message_limit, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_byte_limit, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    clear_receive_queue_current();
  }
  if (connection >= 0 && server != nullptr && !server->abort((uint32_t)connection))
    printf("[network] Terminal connection already removed during teardown.\n");
  pending_connected.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
  pending_disconnected.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
  z80_terminal_browser_disconnect();
  reset_session();
}

bool send_control(uint8_t type, uint32_t sequence) {
  uint8_t frame[HEADER_BYTES] = {type};
  write_sequence(frame + 1, sequence);
  return server->sendMessage((uint32_t)active_connection.load(), frame,
                             sizeof(frame));
}

void check_reboot_deadline() {
  if (!reboot_deadline_active)
    return;
  uint32_t status = reboot_status.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
  while (status == Z80_WEB_REBOOT_REQUESTED || status == Z80_WEB_REBOOT_FLUSHING ||
         status == Z80_WEB_REBOOT_RESTARTING) {
    if (!time_reached(reboot_deadline))
      return;
    if (reboot_status.compare_exchange_weak(status, Z80_WEB_REBOOT_TIMEOUT,
                                             std::memory_order_acq_rel)) {
      printf("[web] Reboot timed out waiting for supervisor progress. "
             "No forced reset; inspect USB supervisor status.\n");
      break;
    }
  }
  reboot_deadline_active = false;
}

void report_reboot_status() {
  uint32_t status = reboot_status.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
  if (protocol_ready && status != reported_reboot_status && send_control(REBOOT_STATUS, status)) {
    reported_reboot_status = status;
    // A watchdog reset sends no TCP FIN. Close explicitly while the network is
    // still alive so the browser can reconnect without waiting for TCP timeout.
    if (status == Z80_WEB_REBOOT_RESTARTING)
      close_connection(*server, (uint32_t)active_connection.load());
  }
}

void retry_input_ack() {
  if (input_ack_pending && send_control(INPUT_ACK, input_sequence - 1))
    input_ack_pending = false;
}

void accept_pending_input() {
  if (!pending_input_length ||
      !z80_terminal_browser_try_receive(pending_input, pending_input_length))
    return;
  pending_input_length = 0;
  ++input_sequence;
  input_ack_pending = true;
  retry_input_ack();
}

void on_connect(WebSocketServer &websocket, uint32_t connection) {
  int32_t expected = -1;
  if (active_connection.compare_exchange_strong(
          expected, (int32_t)connection, std::memory_order_acq_rel)) {
    reset_receive_queue_usage();
    pending_connected.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
  } else {
    close_connection(websocket, connection);
    printf("[network] Terminal busy; rejected another browser.\n");
  }
}

void on_close(WebSocketServer &, uint32_t connection) {
  int32_t expected = (int32_t)connection;
  if (active_connection.compare_exchange_strong(
          expected, -1, std::memory_order_acq_rel)) {
    last_disconnected_connection.store((int32_t)connection,
                                        std::memory_order_release);
    set_disconnect_reason(Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_DISCONNECT_SOCKET_CLOSED);
    clear_receive_queue_current();
    pending_disconnected.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
  }
}

void on_message(WebSocketServer &, uint32_t connection,
                const void *data, size_t length) {
  if (active_connection.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != (int32_t)connection)
    return;
  const uint8_t *frame = static_cast<const uint8_t *>(data);
  if (length < HEADER_BYTES) {
    printf("[network] FAIL: invalid terminal protocol; reload the terminal page.\n");
    disconnect_client(Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_DISCONNECT_PROTOCOL_ERROR);
    return;
  }
  uint32_t sequence = read_sequence(frame + 1);
  if (frame[0] == READY && length == HEADER_BYTES &&
      sequence == PROTOCOL_VERSION) {
    protocol_ready = true;
    report_reboot_status();
    if (ping_retry == nil_time)
      ping_retry = make_timeout_time_ms(HEARTBEAT_MS);
    note_browser_activity();
  } else if (frame[0] == REBOOT && protocol_ready &&
             length == HEADER_BYTES && sequence == 0) {
    note_browser_activity();
    uint32_t status = reboot_status.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    // Repeated commands cannot restart an active operation. Failure can be
    // retried, but only core 0 decides whether it is safe to proceed.
    while (status != Z80_WEB_REBOOT_REQUESTED &&
           status != Z80_WEB_REBOOT_FLUSHING &&
           status != Z80_WEB_REBOOT_RESTARTING &&
           status != Z80_WEB_REBOOT_TIMEOUT) {
      if (reboot_status.compare_exchange_weak(status, Z80_WEB_REBOOT_REQUESTED,
                                               std::memory_order_acq_rel)) {
        reboot_deadline = make_timeout_time_ms(REBOOT_DEADLINE_MS);
        reboot_deadline_active = true;
        break;
      }
    }
    reported_reboot_status = UINT32_MAX;
  } else if (frame[0] == OUTPUT_ACK && protocol_ready &&
             length == HEADER_BYTES) {
    note_browser_activity();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < output_count; ++i) {
      const OutputFrame &candidate = output_frames[(output_head + i) % OUTPUT_WINDOW];
      if (candidate.sent && read_sequence(candidate.data + 1) == sequence) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j)
          retained_output_bytes -=
              output_frames[(output_head + j) % OUTPUT_WINDOW].length - HEADER_BYTES;
        output_head = (output_head + i + 1) % OUTPUT_WINDOW;
        output_count -= i + 1;
        publish_buffer_usage();
        break;
      }
    }
  } else if (frame[0] == INPUT && protocol_ready &&
             length > HEADER_BYTES && length <= HEADER_BYTES + INPUT_BYTES) {
    note_browser_activity();
    if (sequence == input_sequence) {
      size_t bytes = length - HEADER_BYTES;
      if (pending_input_length &&
          (pending_input_length != bytes ||
           memcmp(pending_input, frame + HEADER_BYTES, bytes) != 0)) {
        printf("[network] FAIL: changed pending terminal input; disconnecting.\n");
        disconnect_client(Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_DISCONNECT_PROTOCOL_ERROR);
        return;
      }
      memcpy(pending_input, frame + HEADER_BYTES, bytes);
      pending_input_length = bytes;
      accept_pending_input();
    } else if (sequence == input_sequence - 1) {
      input_ack_pending = true;
      retry_input_ack();
    } else {
      printf("[network] FAIL: out-of-order terminal input; disconnecting.\n");
      disconnect_client(Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_DISCONNECT_PROTOCOL_ERROR);
    }
  } else {
    printf("[network] FAIL: invalid terminal frame; reload the terminal page.\n");
    disconnect_client(Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_DISCONNECT_PROTOCOL_ERROR);
  }
}

void on_pong(WebSocketServer &, uint32_t connection,
             const void *data, size_t length) {
  if (active_connection.load() != (int32_t)connection)
    return;
  if (awaiting_pong && length == sizeof(ping_payload) &&
      memcmp(data, ping_payload, length) == 0) {
    awaiting_pong = false;
    missed_pongs = 0;
    activity_since_ping = false;
    pong_deadline = nil_time;
  } else {
    // Even a late PONG proves the peer is responsive and can satisfy a
    // newer ping's liveness check through note_browser_activity().
    note_browser_activity();
  }
}

void process_events() {
  if (pending_disconnected.exchange(false, std::memory_order_acq_rel)) {
    auto reason = (WebSocketServer::CloseReason)pending_ws_close_reason.load(
        std::memory_order_acquire);
    int transport_error = pending_ws_transport_error.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    printf("[network] WebSocket server closed connection: %s",
           ws_close_reason_name(reason));
    if (transport_error)
      printf(" (lwIP error=%d)", transport_error);
    printf("; queue=%lu/%lu messages, peak=%lu/%lu; bytes=%lu/%lu, peak=%lu/%lu.\n",
           (unsigned long)__atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_messages,
                                          __ATOMIC_RELAXED),
           (unsigned long)__atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_message_limit,
                                          __ATOMIC_RELAXED),
           (unsigned long)__atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_peak_messages,
                                          __ATOMIC_RELAXED),
           (unsigned long)__atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_message_limit,
                                          __ATOMIC_RELAXED),
           (unsigned long)__atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_bytes,
                                          __ATOMIC_RELAXED),
           (unsigned long)__atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_byte_limit,
                                          __ATOMIC_RELAXED),
           (unsigned long)__atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_peak_bytes,
                                          __ATOMIC_RELAXED),
           (unsigned long)__atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_byte_limit,
                                          __ATOMIC_RELAXED));
    z80_terminal_browser_disconnect();
    reset_session();
  }
  if (pending_connected.exchange(false, std::memory_order_acq_rel) &&
      active_connection.load(std::memory_order_acquire) >= 0) {
    reset_session();
    z80_terminal_browser_connect();
  }
}

bool ensure_server() {
  if (server_started)
    return true;
  if (!time_reached(server_retry_deadline))
    return false;
  if (server == nullptr) {
    server = new (std::nothrow) WebSocketServer(SERVER_CONNECTIONS);
    if (server == nullptr) {
      printf("[network] FAIL: server allocation; retry in 5 seconds.\n");
      server_retry_deadline = make_timeout_time_ms(SERVER_RETRY_MS);
      return false;
    }
    server->setConnectCallback(on_connect);
    server->setCloseCallback(on_close);
    server->setCloseDetailsCallback(on_close_details);
    server->setMessageCallback(on_message);
    server->setPongCallback(on_pong);
    server->setTcpNoDelay(true);
    // ACK/PONG control messages are tiny but can arrive in a burst within one
    // CYW43 poll. Give the queue room to absorb that burst, then drain more of
    // it on each application poll; the byte cap still bounds payload storage.
    if (!server->setReceiveLimits({HEADER_BYTES + INPUT_BYTES, 1024, 64, 32})) {
      printf("[network] FAIL: terminal receive limits; retry in 5 seconds.\n");
      delete server;
      server = nullptr;
      server_retry_deadline = make_timeout_time_ms(SERVER_RETRY_MS);
      return false;
    }
  }
  server_started = server->startListening(SERVER_PORT);
  if (!server_started) {
    printf("[network] FAIL: HTTP/WebSocket listen; retry in 5 seconds.\n");
    server_retry_deadline = make_timeout_time_ms(SERVER_RETRY_MS);
  }
  return server_started;
}

void poll_output() {
  int32_t connection = active_connection.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
  if (connection < 0)
    return;
  if (output_count && time_reached(output_frames[output_head].deadline)) {
    increment_stat(terminal_stats.ack_timeouts);
    printf("[network] Terminal client timed out; restoring USB.\n");
    disconnect_client(Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_DISCONNECT_OUTPUT_ACK_TIMEOUT);
    return;
  }
  if (awaiting_pong && time_reached(pong_deadline)) {
    awaiting_pong = false;
    pong_deadline = nil_time;
    if (activity_since_ping) {
      missed_pongs = 0;
    } else {
      increment_stat(terminal_stats.pong_timeouts);
      ++missed_pongs;
      if (missed_pongs > MAX_MISSED_PONGS) {
        printf("[network] Terminal client missed too many PONGs; restoring USB.\n");
        disconnect_client(Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_DISCONNECT_PONG_TIMEOUT);
        return;
      }
    }
    activity_since_ping = false;
    // Keep the 30-second send cadence; enqueue backpressure is retried on the
    // normal short retry cadence.
  }
  if (protocol_ready && !awaiting_pong && time_reached(ping_retry)) {
    write_sequence(ping_payload, ++ping_sequence);
    if (server->sendPing((uint32_t)connection, ping_payload,
                         sizeof(ping_payload))) {
      awaiting_pong = true;
      activity_since_ping = false;
      // A queued ping is outstanding until its matching PONG or the client
      // timeout. Do not retransmit it every poll; retry only failed enqueues.
      ping_retry = make_timeout_time_ms(HEARTBEAT_MS);
      pong_deadline = make_timeout_time_ms(PONG_TIMEOUT_MS);
    } else {
      ping_retry = make_timeout_time_ms(FRAME_RETRY_MS);
    }
  }
  if (!protocol_ready) {
    if (time_reached(hello_retry)) {
      send_control(HELLO, PROTOCOL_VERSION);
      hello_retry = make_timeout_time_ms(FRAME_RETRY_MS);
    }
    return;
  }
  bool output_changed = false;
  while (output_count < OUTPUT_WINDOW) {
    OutputFrame &frame = output_frames[(output_head + output_count) % OUTPUT_WINDOW];
    // ACKs advance head and reduce count together, preserving this staging slot.
    size_t supplied = z80_terminal_supply(
        frame.data + HEADER_BYTES + staged_output_length,
        FRAME_BYTES - staged_output_length);
    staged_output_length += supplied;
    output_changed |= supplied != 0;
    if (!staged_output_length)
      break;
    if (staged_output_length < FRAME_BYTES && !time_reached(output_batch_deadline))
      break;
    frame.data[0] = OUTPUT;
    write_sequence(frame.data + 1, output_sequence++);
    frame.length = HEADER_BYTES + staged_output_length;
    frame.retry = nil_time;
    frame.deadline = make_timeout_time_ms(OUTPUT_ACK_TIMEOUT_MS);
    frame.sent = false;
    retained_output_bytes += staged_output_length;
    ++output_count;
    output_changed = true;
    staged_output_length = 0;
    output_batch_deadline = make_timeout_time_us(OUTPUT_COALESCE_US);
  }
  if (output_changed)
    publish_buffer_usage();
  bool queued = false;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < output_count; ++i) {
    OutputFrame &frame = output_frames[(output_head + i) % OUTPUT_WINDOW];
    if (time_reached(frame.retry)) {
      auto result = server->enqueueMessage((uint32_t)connection, frame.data, frame.length);
      if (result == WebSocketServer::SendResult::would_block)
        break;
      if (result != WebSocketServer::SendResult::queued) {
        printf("[network] FAIL: terminal output enqueue (%u); restoring USB.\n",
               (unsigned)result);
        disconnect_client(Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_DISCONNECT_OUTPUT_SEND_ERROR);
        return;
      }
      queued = true;
      if (frame.sent)
        increment_stat(terminal_stats.retransmits);
      frame.sent = true;
      frame.retry = make_timeout_time_ms(FRAME_RETRY_MS);
    }
    if (!frame.sent)
      break;
  }
  if (queued && !server->flush((uint32_t)connection))
    increment_stat(terminal_stats.flush_failures);
}
}  // namespace

      __atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.retransmits, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);

  stats.ack_timeouts =

  stats.pong_timeouts =

  stats.window_frames =
      __atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.window_frames, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  stats.window_frames_peak =
      __atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.window_frames_peak, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  stats.retained_bytes =
      __atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.retained_bytes, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  stats.retained_bytes_peak =
      __atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.retained_bytes_peak, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  stats.staged_bytes =

  stats.last_disconnect_reason =

  stats.last_ws_close_reason =
      __atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_close_reason, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  stats.last_ws_transport_error =
      __atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_transport_error, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  stats.last_ws_queue_messages =
      __atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_messages, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  stats.last_ws_queue_bytes =
      __atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_bytes, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  stats.last_ws_queue_peak_messages =
      __atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_peak_messages,
                      __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  stats.last_ws_queue_peak_bytes =
      __atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_peak_bytes, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  stats.last_ws_queue_message_limit =
      __atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_message_limit,
                      __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  stats.last_ws_queue_byte_limit =
      __atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.last_ws_queue_byte_limit, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  stats.rx_queue_messages =
      __atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_messages, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  stats.rx_queue_bytes =
      __atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_bytes, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  stats.rx_queue_peak_messages =
      __atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_peak_messages, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  stats.rx_queue_peak_bytes =
      __atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_peak_bytes, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  stats.rx_queue_message_limit =
      __atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_message_limit, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  stats.rx_queue_byte_limit =
      __atomic_load_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_byte_limit, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);

  int32_t connection = active_connection.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
  if (server != nullptr && connection >= 0) {
    WebSocketServer::ReceiveQueueStats queue;
    if (server->getReceiveQueueStats((uint32_t)connection, queue)) {
      stats.rx_queue_active = 1;
      stats.rx_queue_messages = (uint32_t)queue.queuedMessages;
      stats.rx_queue_bytes = (uint32_t)queue.queuedBytes;
      stats.rx_queue_peak_messages = (uint32_t)queue.peakQueuedMessages;
      stats.rx_queue_peak_bytes = (uint32_t)queue.peakQueuedBytes;
      stats.rx_queue_message_limit = (uint32_t)queue.messageLimit;
      stats.rx_queue_byte_limit = (uint32_t)queue.byteLimit;
      __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_messages,
                       stats.rx_queue_messages, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
      __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_bytes,
                       stats.rx_queue_bytes, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
      __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_peak_messages,
                       stats.rx_queue_peak_messages, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
      __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_peak_bytes,
                       stats.rx_queue_peak_bytes, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
      __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_message_limit,
                       stats.rx_queue_message_limit, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
      __atomic_store_n(&terminal_stats.rx_queue_byte_limit,
                       stats.rx_queue_byte_limit, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    }
  }
  return stats;
}

extern "C" void z80_web_terminal_poll(bool online, uint32_t generation) {
  check_reboot_deadline();
  if (!online && !network_online && generation == session_network_generation)
    return;
  if (!online && server == nullptr) {
    session_network_generation = generation;
    return;
  }
  cyw43_arch_lwip_begin();
  if (!online || generation != session_network_generation) {
    disconnect_client(Z80_WEB_TERMINAL_DISCONNECT_NETWORK_LOST);
    session_network_generation = generation;
  }
  network_online = online;
  if (online && ensure_server()) {
    process_events();
    server->popMessages();
    process_events();
    accept_pending_input();
    retry_input_ack();
    report_reboot_status();
    poll_output();
  } else if (server != nullptr) {
    server->popMessages();
    process_events();
  }
  cyw43_arch_lwip_end();
}

extern "C" z80_web_reboot_status_t z80_web_terminal_reboot_status(void) {
  return (z80_web_reboot_status_t)reboot_status.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
}

extern "C" bool z80_web_terminal_begin_reboot(void) {
  uint32_t expected = Z80_WEB_REBOOT_REQUESTED;
  return reboot_status.compare_exchange_strong(expected, Z80_WEB_REBOOT_FLUSHING,
                                                std::memory_order_acq_rel);
}

extern "C" void z80_web_terminal_set_reboot_status(z80_web_reboot_status_t status) {
  if (status == Z80_WEB_REBOOT_CPM_READY) {
    uint32_t expected = Z80_WEB_REBOOT_IDLE;
    reboot_status.compare_exchange_strong(expected, status, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
  } else {
    uint32_t previous = reboot_status.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    // Timeout is terminal for this boot. A late supervisor must not overwrite
    // it with progress, or allow a browser retry to resurrect a cancelled stop.
    while (previous != Z80_WEB_REBOOT_TIMEOUT &&
           !reboot_status.compare_exchange_weak(previous, status,
                                                std::memory_order_acq_rel)) {}
  }
}
